prompt: Summarize how a build system should report a flaky integration test without hiding the original failure signal.
List the checks an ML engineer should run before publishing a checkpoint produced by a short fine-tuning smoke test.
Explain why an inference export pipeline records both row counts and checksums for generated artifacts.
Given a Python package with optional CUDA kernels, describe a concise import-time diagnostic for missing GPU extensions.
Write a short incident note for a model endpoint whose readiness probe is healthy but whose request latency is rising.
Describe how to compare two JSONL prediction files for semantic completeness before computing aggregate metrics.
Explain why a deployment script should verify the resolved model path instead of trusting an environment variable alone.
Give a bounded plan for validating that a local tokenizer and model checkpoint are compatible.
Summarize the difference between an evaluation row being started, completed, and accepted by a downstream metrics script.
Describe a useful progress file schema for a long-running GPU evaluation export.
Explain why top-k logits are often enough for a smoke validation artifact even when full logits are too large to store.
List the common causes of a CUDA out-of-memory failure during model evaluation and how to separate them from input errors.
Write a concise checklist for confirming that a model evaluation used the intended local checkpoint and not a remote download.
Describe how an operator can tell whether a GPU job is making progress using only logs, output files, and nvidia-smi.
Explain why batch size, maximum sequence length, and dtype should be recorded in an evaluation metrics file.
Draft a short README paragraph for a deterministic logits export artifact used by downstream regression tests.
Describe how to retry a failed evaluation shard without overwriting evidence from the first attempt.
Explain why an evaluation script should write partial progress before starting each batch and after completing it.
List the fields that should be included in a GPU evaluation manifest so a later reviewer can reproduce the run.
Explain why a task runner should distinguish dependency failures from genuine resource-pressure failures.
Give a short plan for validating an OpenAI-compatible local endpoint before sending a high-concurrency request batch.
Describe how to compute a stable checksum over a JSONL artifact whose row order is deterministic.
Explain why a metrics file should include elapsed time but not rely on elapsed time as the only success signal.
Summarize how to preserve useful evidence when an evaluation completes more slowly than expected but still writes all rows.
